title: Candidate lumen material
description: Optional 3D display exclusion of the two screenshot-reviewed intraluminal candidates. Measured material identity is uncertain; these are not proven acquisition artifacts. Original CT sections and source data remain unchanged.
coordinateConvention: Main explorer endpoint convention: acquisition XYZ maps to world (x,z,-y).
fineToMaskUv: (fineXYZ - lowerFullFineXYZ + 0.5) / dimensionsXYZ; outside [lower-0.5, upper-0.5) returns zero; nearest R8 normalized sample > 0.5 means hide.

policy.strongProtection: Every strong-signal connected component extending outside the reviewed object envelope, plus guard, using the union from sigma0.8 and sigma0.5 fields. Bright isolated specks wholly within candidate material may be included.
policy.selection: Connected source foreground touching reviewed seeds within local ellipsoidal envelopes; anchored strong structures and neighborhoods excluded. Atrial long sheet and all attachments outside compact round-nodule envelope preserved. No global component or chamber deletion.

limitations: Material classification is unverified. Original display is the default.
The large attached atrial sheet, bright internal structure, and thin attachment on Y=1224 were deliberately retained.
Some protected or source-supported tiny fragments remain. No mask expansion was used to chase them.
Mask applies to optional 3D display and relevant density/shadow/cut-face paths only, never to 2D measured CT sections or raw data.
